_comment: Copy to profile.json (gitignored) and fill in. This is Proteus's matching profile — score_jobs.py consumes it deterministically; the archon also reads it for resume/CV tailoring context.
name: FULL NAME

skills._comment_skills: keyword -> weight; higher = more important. Matched word-boundary, case-insensitive, in title+description.

preferences._comment_preferences: freeform keyword -> +/- score adjustment applied after the bands

culture_flags: Things to check in company research — not keyword-matched; the archon weighs these when researching the employer.
resume_source: PATH OR URL to the current resume Proteus tailors from
experience_summary: 2-6 sentence factual summary of career highlights Proteus may draw on when the resume lacks an angle the job needs.
